description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Cost and Reliability Score for three different models: 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis is labeled "Cost" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score" with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 90, and tick labels at intervals of 10 and an additional label at 50. The 3-Model Ensemble is represented by a blue line with circular markers, solid style, starting at approximately 78 at a Cost of 0 and decreasing to around 72 at a Cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble is depicted by a red line with circular markers, solid style, beginning at about 82 at a Cost of 0 and declining to roughly 70 at a Cost of 10. The GPT-4 model is shown as a yellow line with circular markers, solid style, starting at around 90 at a Cost of 0 and dropping to approximately 38 at a Cost of 10, with a notable decline between Costs of 0 and 2, and continuing to decrease steadily thereafter.
